'''Injure/Kill''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] which allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] to harm an individual's body with the intention of injuring or [[Death/Legends|killing]] them. It was considered to be a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] power<ref name="RPG" /> which was used among the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and classifed as an [[Alter (Jedi Order)|Alter]] ability by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="JP" />

An individual used Injure/Kill to essentially alter part of the target's body.<ref name="RPG" /> The wielder had to be touching their intended target,<ref name="RC">''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]''</ref> although according to the [[Jedi Seer]] [[Sabla-Mandibu]], the Sith were able to use the power on others without reservation from a distance.<ref name="JP" /> Injure/Kill never stunned a target, only result in injury or death if successfully applied.<ref name="RPG" />
